title: EUC+
author: Digitorsion
description: EUC+ v0.2: T-1-style generated notes on top of the stock Euclidean sequencer, off by default on every track. A second FUNC + AMP on the stock Euclidean page opens the EUC+ pages (NOTES, RANDOM), with a per-track ON control. On Euclid hits without parameter locks, audio and MIDI tracks play notes from a pool of scale degrees in the pattern's KB SCALE and ROOT NOTE (or EUC+'s own), moved by a phrase shape and a seeded, lockable random sequence; the phrase restarts on PLAY. Settings in RAM.
